csv_project_name: Engineering for Silverbell Rd El Camino del Cerro to Ina Rd
csv_agency: Pima County Procurement Dept - Design & Construct
csv_scope_of_work: Pima County is seeking Statements of Qualifications (SOQ) from qualified firms to provide design engineering services for Segment III of the Silverbell Road Improvement Project that extends approximately 4 miles between El Camino del Cerro and Ina Road located in Pima County, Arizona. This segment traverses through portions of the City of Tucson, unincorporated Pima County, and the Town of Marana. This project consists of, but is not limited to, planning, coordination with cultural resources review and utilities, right-of-way exhibits, environmental assessments, community engagement, and conceptual and technical design. This project may be funded partially or entirely by the Regional Transportation Authority (RTA).
csv_disciplines_requested: Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Planning/Master Planning, Sanitation Engineering, Archaeology, Hydrology/Hydraulics, Stormwater, Traffic Design Engineering
